'''Nate Hyde Feet of Stench''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Nate Hyde]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-13558">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13558 Feet of Stench], DeckTech (nate "deadbeat" hyde, 10 February 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13558/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13558/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018053627/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13558/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Nate Hyde]]
* '''Published:''' 10 February 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Feet of Stench''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 FOS Hyde DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
